question: Does monster proration (p[slot]) change on every hit, or only on the first hit?
answer: Default: only the FIRST damaging hit of one action instance on each target changes p[slot]. Later hits of the same action instance on the same target do not change it (they still read the current p[slot] in the damage formula). A few skills bypass this gate and change p[slot] on every hit.

damage_side: Every hit (not only the first) reads the current p[slot] through TemplateAssignment -> GetTargetExpRate -> ExpRate step.
